notes.title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero - Major Update: Breaking the Silence!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="xJklrHq30qw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i][u](Due to Steam's 5 MB file limit, the quality of our GIFs has been reduced. For high-resolution graphics, you can watch our YouTube video.)[/u][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4feaca7ce606055f619ee156933b34b01d43f63c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Eternity’s Echo Community,[/p][p]After months of deep silence, we are finally here. That silence had a purpose: we were working on an update that not only improves Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero but completely reimagines it, reshaping every part to deliver the dark, ruthless, and immersive experience we envisioned.[/p][p]That day is today.[/p][p]These update notes are not just a list of changes but a manifesto of our dedication, passion, and the effort we have poured into every detail of the game’s DNA. Without skipping a single detail, here are the revolutionary innovations:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/429de9ecb0a2fb1d71a772662e40f41419701170.png"][/img][/p][h1]I. MECHANICS: THE EVOLUTION OF GAMEPLAY[/h1][p]We unified the core mechanics of the game into a living, interconnected system. Every feature now influences and triggers another.[/p][h2]Core System Integration & Bug Fixing [/h2][p]The backbone of this update is the seamless integration of all existing systems. Every mechanic added since the demo now communicates and interacts with one another. Your actions will create interconnected consequences. We have also resolved all potential issues within this massive system network to deliver a more stable and fluid gameplay experience.[/p][h2]Perspective Revolution: Fully FPS Interaction [/h2][p]We have overhauled the basic interaction system to draw you deeper into the world. Inspecting objects and adding items to your inventory is now done entirely from a first-person (FPS) perspective rather than third-person (TPS). This allows you to feel every detail more closely. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/46e66a89f72d00264e3e14622b37c81b8288ee76.gif"][/img]As part of this change, equipment like the flashlight has been moved from the weapon to the character’s head for better realism and usability.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/55fb048ac3f8bdfd3b0fdccfe32e7b351b69b4f9.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Ultra-Detailed Tactical Magazine Management [/h2][p]Reloading is now a strategic decision.[/p][p]● [b]Your Choice:[/b] A new menu option lets you pick your playstyle. You can reload quickly and sacrifice the bullets left in the mag, or take your time and save the remaining rounds. In times of scarcity, this could mean the difference between life and death.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7a79a0306b768c2e8d56827ab5530abcc811cee7.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Manual Ammo Check:[/b] By holding “R,” you can now remove your magazine and check the remaining rounds in real time. No more surprises.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/8f09fd8ca387ca60cf681b58ef8163daa8856f46.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Animation Depth:[/b] Dozens of new, detailed reload animations depending on whether your weapon is empty, half-full, or nearly full.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/8fc84184c07bae98efeeca4e3ac118f20406dc63.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/6c68b92d95ed5b48be0c6bf8ad5706251e2b8d0f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/e476140ed63a6577530dc58a47ce95e929b9c935.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]New Mechanic:[/b] The Rise of the Techblade & Advanced Mods Your throwable and recallable blade, the Techblade, has grown deadlier.[/p][p][b]● Electric Mode Activated:[/b] The new electric mode is fully functional, complete with striking visual effects. It can temporarily stun AIs, electrify water surfaces, and play a crucial role in environmental puzzles.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/c575d6547f7e674453ab8d57e4e4e9b340501b48.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Time-Based Strategy:[/b] Mods are no longer infinite. You must carefully plan which mode to use and when.[/p][p][b]● Instant Switching:[/b] A new menu system allows quick switching between mods to adapt to the flow of combat instantly.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/195b2b8bcd1d534c6fd0174db80f8bd625d77afd.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Advanced Healthwatch & Data Screens [/h2][p]Your watch has evolved into a survival hub. Beyond tracking health and heartbeat, it now includes expanded screens offering much more data and functionality, becoming a control center tailored to your needs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4ec678a2aa6c8fdfceef7d33635765382cb04825.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Push Your Limits with Dash & Slide [/h2][p]Your character now has new acrobatic abilities that make you unstoppable.[/p][p][b]● Dash:[/b] Evade bullets, change cover, or slip behind enemies with a burst of speed. Those critical seconds may save you.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/47e340b25c61ce2d993e71b29c397499efe72aa7.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Slide:[/b] Maintain momentum and dodge enemy fire by sliding under obstacles.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/82c8c83e9f0423d652af9e0e2cb44147c11e44b7.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Fighting Desperation: Healing & Dynamic Cover[/h2][p][b]● Self-Healing:[/b] You can now recover health at critical moments using special collectible equipment found in the environment.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/29d8113da472962d5254eb86d5793bbbb11d433d.gif"][/img]  [/p][p]  [/p][p][b]● Dynamic Barricades:[/b] Are you caught in the middle of a fight? Interact with nearby objects like tables or cabinets to knock them over and create instant cover in combat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/bf675a95762bd22c390b58d2942617dff5667940.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Other Vital Mechanic Improvements[/h2][p][b]● Leaning Left & Right:[/b] Peek and shoot from cover safely with an improved lean system.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/ed791079403829c6e7fc5c0f1eddbded128a9b45.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Layered Health Feedback:[/b] Health is no longer just a number. Visual and audio cues intensify danger based on the severity of damage.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/001ea5123c3708f2da9ee682b447ea6ae06709b8.png"][/img]  [/p][p][b]● Alternative Ways:[/b] Locked doors are no longer the end. A new system gives you layered options for entering. (More details on this soon!)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/f6c6557904cf9750de174b2a5f995aba161d37ac.gif"][/img][/p][p]Realistic, destructible glass adds cinematic impact to combat[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/d77dec014b5d67f3c3f32f4900b246356d9fe97d.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][b]● Information-Based Puzzle System:[/b] A new puzzle mechanic tests your observation skills by requiring you to gather environmental clues.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/aab7f924cb5fbaadbee1c504902c1a29178c5b28.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/c215ca4e9154beee862594df8675d5cae80c2d58.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]● New Menus & Full Control:[/b] We redesigned both main and pause menus. Custom keybinding gives players complete freedom to play their way.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/64bd94d28b26f0ed13e5ed9d1837c2b021e464b9.png"][/img][/p][h1]II. HUMAN AI: SMART, RUTHLESS & REALISTIC[/h1][p]Enemies are no longer scripted puppets. They think, react, and hunt you.[/p][h2]Advanced Behavior Trees & Tactical Intelligence [/h2][p]Tested across countless scenarios, enemies now feature:[/p][p][b]● Situational Awareness:[/b] Enemies drop whatever they are doing (patrolling, repairing, etc.) if they see you. They react to nearby gunfire and return to their duties if you’re out of range.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/3c17b627472cb2def867a9396aa9ce97529a9f5b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]● Smarter Sound Detection:[/b] They no longer rush blindly toward noise. Instead, they approach cautiously, scanning the area.  [/p][p][b]● Cover Logic:[/b] Enemies won’t fire at you through solid objects like walls, but will shoot through glass.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/80f215468b10b03c291f932c6b493ba7db5c4041.gif"][/img][/p][h2]A Living World: AI Routines[/h2][p]Enemies now feel part of a living world, with routines like:[/p][p]● Patrolling specific routes[/p][p]● Standing guard between two points[/p][p]● Stopping for conversations[/p][p]● Wandering randomly while mumbling[/p][p]● Doing single tasks (cleaning, repairing, etc.) until combat breaks out[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/8f712c814b6600d584dfdaa41823dea1207ae4c5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/40de25e08f2205ece15cd78412faa6e2c17e357b.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/50f6bc758533a19bc88968598d92100babe26b25.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/60b3db767ec093d028465bb7e1c490978d01380e.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/057181598e20b7215993138824451c5e568abe98.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4fe1b4eaf08ec7c22ae9fd5a5941a7278af5f62a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7c012a32d62c2ae66d7935a3e9f04c82d2d8824c.gif"][/img][/carousel][h2]Reactive Dialogue System: Listen to Them! [/h2][p]Enemies now talk, reflecting their state and environment:[/p][p]● Express pain or anger when hit[/p][p]● Reacting not only to footsteps or gunfire but also to your UV light, flashlight, and even the sound of your thrown Techblade.[/p][p]● Display shock at discovering bodies or anger when comrades die mid-combat.[/p][p]● Engaging in situational chatter during patrols, work, and reloads[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/ba307d9965d217bcb2ef9e1f05a72fd3a0560b6b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Location-Based Damage: Every Bullet Matters [/h2][p]Every bullet counts. Enemies play specific animations based on hit location and collapse realistically with ragdoll physics. Shoot their weapon arm, and they’ll drop their gun in panic, switching to a sidearm.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7a83ada496e97c0aa2228d453e6552ed3bfafb6d.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/acc1295c231e2ee538ca7b5492b0056aae693da9.gif"][/img][/carousel][h1]III. CREATURE AI: NIGHTMARE OF THE DV’s[/h1][p]Dimensional Visitors (DVs) are now wilder, smarter, and terrifying.[/p][h2]Predator Instincts: Sight & Sound[/h2][p]They rely primarily on sound and secondarily on limited sight. It may be possible to sneak past them, but even a small noise can trigger a swarm.[/p][h2]Unpredictable Behavior Trees[/h2][p][b]● Exploration Mode:[/b] Follow set patrol routes or roam randomly in search of prey.[/p][p][b]● Hunting Mode:[/b] When hearing a sound, they pause, scan the area, then sprint toward the source. If they don’t see you, they sniff around for a while. Once they do see you, relentless pursuit begins.[/p][p][b]● Group Attacks:[/b] With enough DVs, they try to surround and cut off escape routes, moving smartly without colliding. Obstacles like falls won’t stop them; they’ll get up and continue the chase.[/p][h2]Wild Reactions: Physics-Based Damage [/h2][p]Every bullet impacts them realistically. In this entirely physics-based system, they stagger, stumble, or collapse depending on where the bullet hits them.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/1a2e6c7a1b03b17c05af040b06f3bce5ffcc2066.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/116c05554df4afc21400e850f91b849ade6b7bcc.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4a2d5bf06a9477412da97eea786f8f38c77a643f.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2]Collective Intelligence: Environmental Query System (EQS) [/h2][p]They’re no longer just mindless monsters. Through EQS, they constantly query their environment to find optimal attack positions. This lets them coordinate, avoid collisions, and attack from multiple angles effectively.[/p][p][/p][p]This update represents our vision and commitment to Eternity’s Echo: Patient Zero. We can’t wait for you to dive back in and experience these new features. Your feedback will continue to guide us as we shape this dark world.[/p][p]Welcome back to hell. This time, you’d better be ready.[/p][p]Sincerely, [/p][p][b]The Eternity’s Echo Development Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/1013256297b7d004f1812538196e729b351987dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Tested across countless scenarios, enemies now feature:
Enemies drop whatever they are doing (patrolling, repairing, etc.) if they see you. They react to nearby gunfire and return to their duties if you’re out of range.
They no longer rush blindly toward noise. Instead, they approach cautiously, scanning the area.
Enemies won’t fire at you through solid objects like walls, but will shoot through glass.
Enemies now feel part of a living world, with routines like:
Patrolling specific routes
Standing guard between two points
Stopping for conversations
Wandering randomly while mumbling
Doing single tasks (cleaning, repairing, etc.) until combat breaks out
Enemies now talk, reflecting their state and environment:
Express pain or anger when hit
Reacting not only to footsteps or gunfire but also to your UV light, flashlight, and even the sound of your thrown Techblade.
Display shock at discovering bodies or anger when comrades die mid-combat.
Engaging in situational chatter during patrols, work, and reloads

Every bullet counts. Enemies play specific animations based on hit location and collapse realistically with ragdoll physics. Shoot their weapon arm, and they’ll drop their gun in panic, switching to a sidearm.
Dimensional Visitors (DVs) are now wilder, smarter, and terrifying.
They rely primarily on sound and secondarily on limited sight. It may be possible to sneak past them, but even a small noise can trigger a swarm.
Exploration Mode: Follow set patrol routes or roam randomly in search of prey.
Hunting Mode: When hearing a sound, they pause, scan the area, then sprint toward the source. If they don’t see you, they sniff around for a while. Once they do see you, relentless pursuit begins.
Group Attacks: With enough DVs, they try to surround and cut off escape routes, moving smartly without colliding. Obstacles like falls won’t stop them; they’ll get up and continue the chase.
Every bullet impacts them realistically. In this entirely physics-based system, they stagger, stumble, or collapse depending on where the bullet hits them.

They’re no longer just mindless monsters. Through EQS, they constantly query their environment to find optimal attack positions. This lets them coordinate, avoid collisions, and attack from multiple angles effectively.

notes.title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero - Ten Thousand Eighth Minute Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]We Added Mouse Sensitivity Adjustment:[/b] Players can now adjust mouse sensitivity.
[*] [b]Invert Y-Axis Option:[/b] Inverted axis control is now available.
[*] [b]Added UI for pre-DV Battle:[/b] We've added a new UI to help before Dimensional Variant (DV) battles.
[*] [b]Added 2K and 4K Resolution Support: [/b]You can now play the game in higher resolutions.
[*] [b]Updated the Main Menu Intro sentence:[/b] We changed the dialog that appears when there are no saves.
[*] [b]Updated Lantern On/Off Mechanics:[/b] We've made using the flashlight in the Interact system more convenient.
[*] [b]Added Rayne's Death Dialogs: [/b]We've added 20 new post-death dialogs, which will give you a different new approach each time you die and give you tips on how to progress through the market.
[*] [b]Adjusted DV Spawn Times:[/b] We made minor balance updates to enemy spawn times.
[*] Incorporated the Last Bike in the Trunk Flyer into the Laplace System: We added a new detail in the context of the story.
[*] [b]Added two new Easter Eggs:[/b] We've added two new surprises for you to discover.
[*] [b]We Updated the Garage Closing Sound: [/b]We added a more realistic sound effect.
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] [b]We Fixed Skyrim Giant Bug:[/b] The hanging man will no longer pop up abnormally when you pause the game.
[*] [b]Fixed Menu Subtitle Bug:[/b] We fixed an issue with subtitles in the menu.
[*] [b]Localization Updates: [/b]Fixed various language bugs.
[*] [b]Updated the Game Launch Icon: [/b]We added a new and more responsive icon.
[*] [b]We Added Stopper UI for Flashlight Use: [/b]We've added an additional, more intuitive notification UI for using the flashlight.
[/list]

With this update, we made both gameplay improvements and technical fixes. Your feedback is very important to us, don't forget to share your comments!

Demonsoft Games Team

notes.title: Summary of Progress: Developer Log from V19.5
notes.content:
We are excited to share the latest updates for Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero. Here are the significant technical improvements and innovations in version 19.5:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/37dd00e13d9216e1d9bf42fe953604d2bb03d57b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/aad24d5ca1e3aeab9be56eb2bec744c99e63cf93.png[/img]
[h3][b]Techblade Energy Level Display[/b] [/h3]
We have made an improvement to display the energy level of our Techblade on the watch on our left wrist. Now, as the energy level fills up, three boxes on the edge of the watch fill in, allowing players to easily track their energy levels. This new feature serves as a visual feedback mechanism that enables players to better plan their combat strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/fa204d7ee21af0c6024dc9725659c5d7ace53b2b.png[/img]
[h3][b]Motel Level Progress[/b]
[/h3]
We have made significant progress in the Motel level. By enhancing the environmental details and playability of this area, we aim to provide a more immersive experience. The new textures, lighting effects, and interactive objects in the Motel level offer players a richer atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4d6c45e79cea7f32839d65d2c8978b360768d705.png[/img]
[h3][b]Forest Level Progress[/b]
[/h3]
Similarly, we have made substantial advancements in the Forest level. By working on environmental details and playability, we have made this area richer and more explorable. The dynamic weather conditions, sound effects, and flora and fauna diversity in the Forest level provide players with a more realistic gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/e4b9e36fd8a8e0149c50838c9c88181457da03da.png[/img]
[h3][b]Enemy AI Improvements[/b]
[/h3]
Improvements have been made to the animations of enemy AI. We have undertaken detailed work to make the movements of AI more fluid and realistic. By updating the movement algorithms of enemy characters, we have ensured they exhibit smarter and more unpredictable behaviors.

Additionally, special work has been done on enemy AI breaking through locked doors. This allows enemies to overcome obstacles in front of players, offering a more dynamic and challenging experience. This new feature adds a game mechanic that requires players to be on alert at all times, increasing the game's tension.

We are happy to push our game further with these updates. Thank you for your continued support and stay tuned for more updates!


Best regards, 
[u][b]The Demonsoft Games Team[/b][/u]

notes.title: Summary of Progress: Developer Log from V19
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/06f6d6000c06477baa3fffdbf05f244a7dd6897a.png[/img]
We're thrilled to share the latest updates and enhancements for Eternity's Echo: Patient 
Zero. Our team has been hard at work, and we've made significant strides in various aspects 
of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/f4e45b0ae5739b1965b259265e05af39093e3f38.png[/img][h3][b]Lighting System and Global Illumination (GI) [/b] 
[/h3]
[list][*] We've revamped our lighting system to enhance the visual experience. 
[*] Upgraded Global Illumination (GI) for more realistic and immersive environments. [b](Lumen)[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]Engine Upgrade[/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Migrated to the latest version of Unreal Engine, ensuring improved performance and access to cutting-edge features. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7423f447d99a25bf7e820c500ba2472ff98d7dd8.png[/img]
[h3][b]Life Mechanics Integration [/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Integrated the life mechanics with the in-game watch, providing a seamless and intuitive player experience. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/c97541f9fb81df0380a9d3383fdc37f966355475.png[/img]
[h3][b]Mini-Game Systems [/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Laid the foundation for various mini-games, adding layers of fun and engagement to the gameplay. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Door and Key Systems [/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developed comprehensive door and key systems, including both locking and unlocking mechanisms for an added layer of interaction and challenge. 
[/list]
[h3][b]ID Card and Authorization Systems[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented an ID card system along with authorization mechanics to control access and add depth to the storyline. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/2d9fd1225282ed4ff3a762f7220134511b25d998.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Playable Areas[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Created new playable areas, expanding the world of Eternity's Echo and offering more exploration opportunities. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Main Menu Enhancements[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the main menu for better navigation and a more polished user experience. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Artificial Intelligence (AI) Improvements[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developed sophisticated AI behaviors, sensitivity, and dominance settings. 
[*] Created environments with proxy links for dynamic transitions. 
[*] Defined AI states and linked them to the Environmental Query System (EQS) for real-time decision-making. For instance, if an AI encounters a door while running, it will either break through if locked or pass through if open. 
[*] Integrated AI states with animation blueprints, ensuring the correct animations play based on the AI's current state. 
[*] Activated physical interactions, allowing AI movements to be based on realistic physics. 
[/list]
We hope these updates bring you as much excitement as they did for us in development. 
Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more updates! 

Best regards, 
[u][b]The Demonsoft Games Team[/b][/u]

notes.title: Summary of Progress: Developer Logs from V1 to V18
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/f154f643b707857e0b5aac4c3aab530202db1895.png[/img]
These developer notes provide a detailed summary of all the changes, improvements, and bug fixes we've worked on so far. Each version note outlines the new features and systems we developed, as well as how we resolved issues in existing systems.

[b][h1]Summary of Developer Notes V1-V18:[/h1]
[/b]
[b][u][h3]Developments and New Features:[/h3]
[/u][/b][list]
[*] Installation and development of fundamental infrastructures such as the realistic locomotion system, realistic weapon system, and level planning (V1).
[*] Addition of game mechanics like the UV mechanics system, story-based save and load system, object pickup, and inventory system (V2-V7).
[*] Implementation of the menu system, authorized door lock system, and creation of AI characters (V8-V12).
[*] Creation of a detailed FPS camera system, character skill system, and various new abilities (V15-V17).
[*] Addition of player movement and interaction mechanics like the character dashing and restriction system (V18).[/list]
[b][u][h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h3][/u][/b][list]
[*] Resolution of various technical issues such as character navigation system errors, reloading and taking ammunition animations, and the UV mechanics timer (V1-V3).
[*] Enhancements in details like light materials, physical material sounds, and animation durations (V4-V5).
[*] Fixes for save and load system issues, camera errors, and performance problems in the inventory system (V7-V10).
[*] Optimization of mission system, AI direction update systems, and environment design (V11-V15).
[*] Performance updates and improvements related to new abilities and FOV settings (V16-V18).
[/list]

These notes have been prepared to detail the progress of our project and document the work done. They serve as a reference point to track which features have been added, which bugs have been fixed, and what improvements have been made.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/b84c7d1bdd24e5a08ca2c872468ae597547f6d6c.png[/img]
[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V1[/h2]
[/b][/u][list]
[*] Realistic locomotion system installation and development
[*] Realistic weapon system setup
[*] Level and settlement planning completed[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Fixed character navigation system bug
[*] Improved climbing mechanics on the 'IK' method
[/list]

[b][u][h2]Developer Notes V2[/h2]
[/u][/b][list]
[*] UV mechanics system established
[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Fixed ammunition reloading error in the weapon system
[*] Adjusted jumping distance in the movement system
[*] Fixed loading error due to height differences in the level
[*] Restructured texture dimensions of background mechanisms in the level
[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V3[/h2]
[/b][/u][list][*] Created reloading and taking ammunition animations and ammunition system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Fixed timer error in UV mechanics
[*] Configured LOD settings of the UV lighting object
[*] Reduced the texture quality of the object to the general size[/list]
[b][u][h2]Developer Notes V4[/h2][/u][/b][list]
[*] Established realistic flashlight system
[*] Created a system for different footstep sounds based on the physical material[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Synchronized the duration of reload and ammunition take animations with the mechanics
[*] Fixed incorrect variable type in the ammunition system
[*] Improved the timing of sound effects in the animation
[/list]

[b][u][h2]Developer Notes V5[/h2][/u][/b][list]
[*] Added transition conditions between UV and flashlight
[*] Created animations for the flashlight system
[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Redesigned the light material used in the flashlight system to enhance realism
[*] Installed 8 new materials in the physical material system and renamed them
[*] Created missing sound files for added materials in the sound creation system
[*] Fixed the socket location of sound effects on the character[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V6[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established a story-based save and load system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Created variables for transition conditions between UV and flashlight systems
[*] Shortened the animation duration of the flashlight system
[/list]


[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V7[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Created object pickup and inspection system
[*] Established inventory system [/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Fixed an error in the save and load system
[*] Adjusted the number of conditions between UV and flashlight
[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V8[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Designed and established menu system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Fixed a variable in the object pickup system
[*] Changed the camera location of the inspection system and brought it closer to the screen
[*] Improved the brightness and area of lighting in the object pickup system
[*] Fixed animation error in the inventory system
[*] Fixed camera error in the inventory system
[*] Fixed naming error in the save system
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/f8b84a08f5000b6265db376ae5933805d7660c11.png[/img]
[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V9[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established story-related evaluation system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Adjusted the position of buttons in the menu system
[*] Improved visual effect lighting for menu design
[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V10[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established an authorized door lock system
[*] Created a system for bullet impact sound and trace based on the physical material
[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Fixed a click error in the evaluation system
[*] Fixed page switching error in the menu system
[*] Disabled a performance module causing slow texture loading in the inventory system[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V11[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established mission system and navigation system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Fixed interaction error in the door lock system
[*] Improved the code block selecting bullet traces
[*] Fixed location error of visual effects for bullets
[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V12[/h2][/b][/u][list][*] Created AI characters
[*] Added a graded card system extension to the door lock system
[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Improved the update method in the mission system
[*] Reduced and optimized the number of variables in the navigation system
[/list]

[u][h2]Developer Notes V13
[/h2][/u][list][*] Separated and classified character conditions
[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*] Fixed an error in the direction update system of AI
[*] Increased the sound detection ranges of AI
[*] Fixed inconsistent variable naming in the new card system
[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V14[/h2][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Completed environment design for the prototype version[/list][u][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][/u][list][*] Fixed an error in the transition of conditions
[*] Updated the cursor in the mission system and increased its visibility
[*] Fixed a timer error in the evaluation system
[*] Updated visuals in the menu system
[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V15[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Created a detailed FPS camera system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Configured LOD settings for objects causing fps drop in environment design
[*] Performed optimization works on environment design
[*] Fixed a delay error in character conditions[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V16[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established character skill system
[*] Developed 'Eternal Sight' skill[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Improved the location of the new camera system
[*] Determined new player field of view (FOV)
[*] Made animation improvements for the new FOV setting
[*] Adjusted weapon and hand positions for the new FOV setting
[*] Fixed an error in the door lock system that caused the lock not to be recognized[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer Notes V17[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established breath-holding system for the character
[*] Created a throwable and recallable knife system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Added simultaneous limitations to the new skill system
[*] Created a new dataset for the skill system
[*] Made performance updates for the Eternal Sight skill
[*] Improved scanning distance for the Eternal Sight skill[/list]

[u][b][h2]Developer  Notes V18[/h2][/b][/u][list]
[*] Established character dashing and restriction system[/list][b][h3]Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Improved the speeds of animations in the breath-holding system
[*] Fixed the calculation code for the condition in the breath-holding system, now works more consistently
[*] Fixed an animation error causing an issue with recalling the throwable knife
[*] Updated the visual effect location while the knife is returning, now follows the knife
[*] Fixed the shadow of the hand in the camera angle in the breath-holding system
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/d6ad759242eaa1c897f96e9dd2fb25a8d996c69a.png[/img]
